items.text: Halo and Draw are one two-icon toggle on the rail: both icons show, the one in use is lit and the other dim, so you can always see that Halo is there. Picking a colour or mark switches Draw on.
The mark icons in the small chips were squashed (ovals and stretched triangles). They are round and square again.
Halo and Draw are now one toggle on the rail: its icon shows the mode you are in, and a tap switches to the other. One button fewer on the right.
Colour and Shape are now one Draw button on the rail (Halo stays its own). Tap it to draw with the chosen colour and mark together; tap again to go back to Halo.
The colour and mark chips are smaller, with less space around them, and the right rail in edit squeezes to fit the stage, so the bottom bar no longer gets pushed off the screen.
The right-hand rail no longer hangs over the bottom bar in play. When its buttons need more room than the stage has, they squeeze slightly (never below 40 px) to fit.
In edit, the heads-up display no longer shows the Performance and MIDI tabs, even while the grid is playing. They come back in play.

The empty strip above the bottom bar is gone in play: the stage takes all the room again. The colour and shape strip appears only in edit, and the bottom bar still sits in exactly the same place in play, hold and edit.

Fixed the vertical jumping: holding notes, or switching hand, hold and pencil, no longer shifts the grid, the colour bar or the bottom bar. In play the side rail now takes the stage's height instead of setting it.
Fixed: holding a note in the hold hand shrank the grid inside its frame, a step each time. The grid now keeps its size however many notes you hold.
